Capture the table and column for each sensitive field
Confirm each field has a classification and owner
Done when the sensitive-field list is captured from the catalog
verify: Sensitive-field list reflects the catalog classifications
Pass when each field has a classification and owner

steps.title: Confirm masking or tokenization policies on those columns in Snowflake
sop: Check each sensitive column for a masking or token policy
Match the policy to the field's classification
Flag any sensitive column with no policy attached
Done when every sensitive column's policy state is recorded
verify: Each sensitive column shows its masking or token policy state
Pass when no sensitive column is missing an expected policy

steps.title: Verify encryption at rest and in transit in Snowflake
sop: Confirm encryption at rest is enabled on the storage
Confirm connections enforce encryption in transit
Record the encryption state as evidence
Done when encryption at rest and in transit is verified
verify: Encryption at rest and in transit is confirmed enabled
Pass when neither encryption control is found disabled

steps.title: Query the sensitive fields as an unauthorized role in Snowflake
sop: Assume a role without entitlement to the sensitive data
Query each sensitive column with that role
Capture the returned values as evidence
Done when each sensitive column is queried as an unauthorized role
verify: Unauthorized query returns masked or denied values
Pass when no sensitive field returns raw values to that role

steps.title: Flag any unprotected column for remediation in the catalog
sop: Identify columns that returned raw or unencrypted values
Flag each with a remediation disposition
Route the flag to the platform owner
Done when every unprotected column is flagged for remediation
verify: Each unprotected column is flagged with a disposition
Pass when no failing column is left unflagged

steps.title: Reconcile tested columns to the catalog restricted list
sop: Compare tested columns to the catalog restricted list
Investigate any restricted field not tested
Store the test evidence with the catalog and policy record
Done when tested columns reconcile to the restricted list
verify: Tested columns reconcile to the catalog restricted list
Pass when every sensitive field passed the masking test

generic.Defined scope/population: Scope is retention and purge jobs mapped to the data lifecycle policy per data type
generic.In-scope period: Verification covers job runs across the current retention cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each job row has data type, schedule, last run and record counts
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Purged record counts reconcile to expected counts from the retention policy
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Job run logs and counts retained with run timestamps
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Non-compliant or failed jobs flagged for remediation with a disposition
generic.Test population: All retention and purge jobs on the warehouse form the population to verify
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: A job passes when it ran on schedule and honored legal-hold exclusions
generic.Exception handling path: Failed or off-schedule jobs route to the orchestrator owner for rerun and fix
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Jobs are compliant when they run per policy and legal holds are honored
generic.Evidence location: Job logs held in the orchestrator with counts verified in the data warehouse

steps.title: Match retention and purge jobs to the policy schedule in the orchestrator
sop: List retention and purge jobs in the pipeline orchestrator
Map each job to a data type and policy schedule
Flag data types with no scheduled purge job
Done when every policy data type maps to a job
verify: Each policy data type maps to a scheduled job
Pass when no in-scope data type lacks a purge job

steps.title: Verify last successful run and record counts in the data warehouse
sop: Check the last successful run time per job
Read the record counts each run purged
Confirm the run fell within the policy window
Done when last-run and counts are captured per job
verify: Each job shows a last successful run and purge count
Pass when no job is missing a recent successful run

steps.title: Confirm legal-hold exclusions are honored in the warehouse
sop: Identify data under active legal hold
Confirm held records were excluded from purge
Flag any held record that was purged
Done when legal-hold exclusions are confirmed honored
verify: Records under legal hold were excluded from purge
Pass when no legal-hold record was purged

steps.title: Reconcile purged counts to expected policy counts
sop: Compute expected purge counts from the policy
Compare them to the actual purged counts
Investigate material variances per job
Done when purged counts reconcile to expected counts
verify: Purged counts reconcile to expected policy counts
Pass when no unexplained count variance remains

steps.title: Flag non-compliant jobs for remediation in the orchestrator
sop: Identify jobs that failed, missed schedule or purged wrongly
Flag each with a remediation disposition
Route the flag to the orchestrator owner for rerun
Done when every non-compliant job is flagged
verify: Each non-compliant job is flagged with a disposition
Pass when no failing job is left unflagged

steps.title: Record verification results with run timestamps in the orchestrator
sop: Store the job logs and counts as verification evidence
Stamp each result with its run timestamp
Summarize compliant versus flagged jobs
Done when verification results are recorded with timestamps
verify: Results are stored with run timestamps per job
Pass when jobs run per schedule and honor legal holds
